title: Mobile Wallet Refund Bases, Amounts and Timing
content:
Finance policy on refunds of **Mobile Wallet** transfers.

## When principal can be refunded
Principal is refunded only on a transfer whose status is cancelled, credit failed or credited, and on a credited transfer only as an error-resolution remedy. The status is read from the transfer's system record.

## Amount by refund basis

| Refund basis | Principal refunded | Fees refunded with it |
|---|---|---|
| cancellation | the principal collected | as the cancellation terms set |
| failed credit | the principal collected, in full, because a failed credit comes back in full | transfer fee as below |
| request for information expired | the principal collected | each booking fee at the tier's share for Paloma-cancelled held transfers, fee-refund reason "compliance cancellation" |
| compliance rejection | the principal collected | each booking fee at the tier's share for Paloma-cancelled held transfers, fee-refund reason "compliance cancellation" |
| error resolution | what the Mobile Wallet error-resolution rules set | as those rules set |
| error shortfall | what the Mobile Wallet error-resolution rules set | as those rules set |

## Transfer fee on a failed-credit refund
- When the last failure was on Paloma's side, the transfer fee is refunded in full, fee-refund reason "failure Paloma side".
- When it was on the recipient's side, the transfer fee is refunded at the tier's share for recipient-side failures, fee-refund reason "failure sender side".
- Card funding, retry and redirect fees are not refunded after a sender-side failure.

## Once per basis
Each refund basis is paid once against its source entry: a refund of the same basis already recorded against the same ledger entry of the same transfer is not paid again.

## Timing and destination
A refund is issued within the tier's refund period in Paloma business days of the day it became owed: the cancellation, the customer's choice, or the end of the failed-credit hold period. It goes to the original funding method; a wire is refunded by ACH credit to the account it came from.

## Effect on the transfer
Once the principal refund is booked the transfer moves to refunded, except that a shortfall refund (refund basis "error shortfall") leaves a credited transfer credited.

### Hypothetical cases

| Tier | Last failure | Transfer fee | Transfer fee refunded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Priority | wallet suspended (recipient's side) | 4.99 | 4.99, at that tier's 100 percent share |
| Mobile Wallet Micro | wallet not registered (recipient's side) | 0.99 | 0.00, at that tier's 0 percent share |
| Mobile Wallet Micro | provider unavailable (Paloma's side) | 0.99 | 0.99, in full |
